steps.step: OCMS creates a work item for each rejected record
steps.detail: No work item creator exists. In DataHiveUenFinService.java:1519 'Create Work Item' is only a PLACEHOLDER comment for a work permit case, not code. There is no work item controller or entity in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (grep 'workitem', 'work.?item'); useEndorsement.tsx:56,119-121 POSTs to a 'workitem' endpoint that has no controller in any repo (for UPL, not court). Nothing is triggered by a court rejection.

steps.step: The work items appear in the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: The Dashboard component only renders an empty <div className="row ..."> (Dashboard.tsx:21-31). The Work Items page is only Meta (utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts:1-12) with no page component and no route in App.tsx, and LinkData.tsx:394-398 marks its menu UNCONFIRMED (commented out).

steps.step: The OIC can use the work item to decide the follow-up
steps.detail: There is no work item list or detail screen, and no rejected record data to show (see OCMS24.17). Only the constants path '/work-item' and title 'Work Items' exist (WorkItem.ts:1-12).
